description: This file implements a version monitor for an etcd cluster, handling version changes, downgrades, and synchronization of cluster and storage versions.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A struct that monitors and manages version states within an etcd cluster.

methods.name: UpdateClusterVersionIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates the cluster version if necessary based on member versions and downgrade status.

methods.name: decideClusterVersion
methods.description: Determines the next cluster version based on member versions and downgrade info.

methods.name: UpdateStorageVersionIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures storage version matches the cluster version, updating if needed.

methods.name: CancelDowngradeIfNeeded
methods.description: Cancels ongoing downgrade if the cluster has reached the target version.

methods.name: membersMinimalServerVersion
methods.description: Finds the minimal server version among cluster members.

methods.name: versionsMatchTarget
methods.description: Checks if all members' server versions match a target version.
